desc: Reduce the problem to minimizing over column masks c the sum over rows of min(popcount(row xor c), W-popcount(row xor c)), i.e. an XOR convolution with kernel K.
Implement input parsing and build the row-mask frequency array of length 2^W.
Compute the kernel Walsh transform exactly using the radial Krawtchouk formula and create kernel_hat[mask]=T[popcount(mask)].
Implement an optimized in-place integer FWHT for XOR transform and inverse (same transform divided by 2^W).
Combine the transformed frequency with kernel_hat, inverse-transform, divide by 2^W, take the minimum, and print the answer.
Test on the samples and small random brute-force cases, including W=1, all zeros, all ones, and a W=18 performance sanity check.
